tagline: Verisk is a leading data, analytics, and technology provider serving clients in the insurance ecosystem.
hero_kpi_rationale: Revenue is the primary indicator of the company's growth, reflecting its ability to sell data and analytics solutions to clients in the insurance sector.

kpis.name: Revenue growth
kpis.explanation: Increase in revenue compared to the prior year, measuring overall business performance.
kpis.description: Revenue growth is a key performance indicator used by Verisk to assess its ability to generate incremental revenues through new sales, cross-selling, and acquisitions.

kpis.name: Subscription revenue share
kpis.explanation: Percentage of total revenue derived from subscription revenues.
kpis.description: Represents the proportion of revenues generated by subscriptions to the company's solutions, which are typically recurring.

kpis.name: Transactional and advisory revenue share
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue derived from transactional solutions and advisory services.
kpis.description: Represents the proportion of revenues generated by transaction-based solutions and consulting services, which help clients derive greater value from analytics.

kpis.short: Personnel Expenses % of Total Operating Expenses
kpis.name: Personnel expenses as % of total operating expenses
kpis.explanation: Percentage of total operating expenses attributable to personnel costs.
kpis.description: Personnel expenses, including salaries and benefits, represent a significant portion of the company's operating costs.
kpis.signal: Indicator of cost structure and labor efficiency.

kpis.name: Total assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 6.2B USD in the latest year

kpis.name: Total debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of 4.9B USD in the latest year

kpis.name: Dividend per share
kpis.description: Dividend per share paid annually, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 declared fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of 0.5 USD in the latest year.

kpis.name: Capital returned (dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders through annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 declared fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders through dividends of 0.251B USD in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout ratio
kpis.description: Payout ratio: dividends paid / net income, calculated over the last 4 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Portion of net income distributed as dividends: 27.6% in the latest year.

kpis.name: Total revenue
kpis.description: Consolidated annual revenue, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 declared fiscal years from 10-K filings.
kpis.signal: Total revenue of 3.073B USD in the latest year.

kpis.name: Net income
kpis.description: Consolidated annual net income, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 declared fiscal years from 10-K filings.
kpis.signal: Net income of 0.908B USD in the latest year.

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company explicitly mentions cybersecurity threats as a significant risk, with elevated language intensity and high-risk context

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a competitive market, with competitors such as FactSet Research Systems Inc. and Thomson Reuters Corporation, which could affect its market share

risks.title: Regulation
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to government regulations, which could affect its business operations and financial results

risks.title: Economic
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to economic fluctuations, including inflation and interest rate changes, which could affect demand for its solutions

risks.title: Customer concentration
risks.score_rationale: The company is heavily dependent on its customers, particularly in the insurance sector, which could affect revenues if these customers reduce spending

ai_positioning.summary: VRSK does not explicitly mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing. The information provided focuses on financial aspects, management, and company operations, with no reference to AI or its applications.
